statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-21716 is a Node.js Permission Model bypass, an incomplete fix for CVE-2024-36137: FileHandle.chmod() and FileHandle.chown() in the promises API did not check write permission, so code under --permission with a restricted --allow-fs-write could change the mode and owner of an already open file. Node.js fixed it for 22.x in 22.22.2, the 2026-03-24 security release (https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/march-2026-security-releases), with commit 06fc3436f6, 'permission: include permission check on lib/fs/promises' (https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/06fc3436f6), which carries this CVE id. Release notes: https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.22.2. The CVE record (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-21716) lists 22.x releases through 22.22.1 as affected. We read the node binary in every published DHI nodejs-22 package for Alpine 3.23 on x86_64 and aarch64: 22.22.2-r0 is the first that reports Node.js v22.22.2; 22.22.0-r0 and 22.22.1-r0 report Node.js 22.22.0 and 22.22.1. We also ran upstream's regression test for the fix (test/parallel/test-permission-fs-write.js) against every published Alpine 3.23 aarch64 build: it fails on 22.22.0-r0 and 22.22.1-r0, and passes on 22.22.2-r0 through 22.23.5-r0. Both earlier builds predate the fix, so the range starts at 0.
